name: devflow-brief
description: Whether a Devflow brief can be planned from: it says what the work is for, what it leaves out, and how success is checked. Asked before the plan; the state is the brief as its fields, never the conversation that wrote it.

goal.instructions: Does the brief state the goal: what the work achieves, and for whom?

criteria.true: a reader can say in one sentence what will be different when the work lands
criteria.false: the goal is missing, or names an activity rather than an outcome

outOfScope.instructions: Does the brief say what is out of scope?

criteria.true: at least one thing the work will not do is named
criteria.false: nothing is ruled out, or only 'none'

success.instructions: Does the brief give a success criterion a person can check: a command, a screen or a number?

criteria.true: the success line names something observable
criteria.false: success is missing, or is a feeling such as 'works well'
